event_text: IT staff notice unusual activity on the Legislature's internal systems and shut down systems and remote access, according to an internal memo
notes: The Dominion Post says Thursday morning; the Legislature gives the date as Nov 19.

event_text: The Legislature confirms a cybersecurity incident; access to some IT systems is disabled and the website is down
notes: Statement reported by The Record, WV MetroNews and The Dominion Post on Friday, Nov 20.
